module: Draws the labels (dark panels with colored border) of the Easy Select tool with the imgui drawList. "followMouse" labels are stacked near the cursor (18 px offset, left side if they exit the viewport); the others are anchored above their screen position. Priority labels (label.priority == true) come first.

draw.desc: Draws all labels of the list.

labels.desc: List of labels {text, color (U32), followMouse, priority, position (ImVec2, if not followMouse)}

viewport.desc: Viewport (Pos and Size) used to keep labels visible
